name: Pantheon
description: Portraits of the extended Greek pantheon, from the primordials to the Olympians and the gods of the wild and the underworld: formless Chaos and patient Gaia, Nyx and her starlit children, devouring Kronos, the sun chariot of Helios, Zeus in the storm, Poseidon in the deep, Hades below and Persephone between two worlds, the forge of Hephaestus, the revels of Dionysus, the pipes of Pan and the cave of Hypnos. Old Greek modes, lyres, auloi, bronze and thunder.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Chaos
sketches.description: Before anything: unshaped noise, drifting filters, a cluster rubbing against itself and pitches that flicker without ever settling into a key.
sketches.source:
setcpm(40/4)

// Before anything: unshaped noise, drifting filters and no key at all
void: s("brown").slow(8).lpf(sine.range(200, 900).slow(24)).gain(.2)
static: s("pink").slow(8).hpf(1500).lpf(perlin.range(2000, 6000).slow(4)).pan(sine.slow(12)).gain(.04)

// Pitches flicker in and out, never settling
sparks: n(irand(12).segment(8)).scale("C:minor pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.8).seed("chaos")
  .s("sine").fm(4).fmh(1.41).decay(.6).sustain(0).release(1)
  .pan(rand).room(.8).size(.95).gain(.1)

// A cluster that slowly rubs against itself
cluster: note("[c2,db2,gb2]").slow(8).s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.5)
  .lpf(400).attack(6).sustain(1).release(8).gain(.12)

sketches.name: Gaia
sketches.description: The earth mother: a deep fifth that never leaves, rivers and living things on her surface and a melody that grows slowly out of the soil.
sketches.source:
setcpm(54/4)

// The ground: a deep open fifth that never leaves
earth: note("[c1,g1,c2]").slow(8).s("sawtooth").lpf(300).attack(4).sustain(1).release(6).gain(.22)
hum: note("c2").slow(8).s("hum").overtone(4).gain(.16)

// Rivers and living things on her surface
stream: s("stream").slow(4).azimuth(-40).distance(3).gain(.22)
birds: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(50).distance(5).gain(.2)
insects: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(140).distance(2).gain(.08)

// Slow growth: a melody rising out of the soil, a step at a time
growth: n("<0 1 2 4 [4 5] 7 [5 4] 2>").scale("C:major").transpose(12)
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(.4).decay(1.5).sustain(.3).release(2)
  .room(.6).gain(.22)

sketches.name: Nyx
sketches.description: Night herself: a low choir breathing in the dark, her sons Sleep and Death at either ear, and stars coming out one by one.
sketches.source:
setcpm(46/4)

// Night herself: a low choir breathing in the dark
choir: note("<[a2,e3,c4] [f2,c3,a3] [d2,a2,f3] [e2,b2,g#3]>").slow(2)
  .s("choir").syl("<oo oh oo ah>").attack(3).release(4).space("hall").gain(.26)

// Her sons Hypnos and Thanatos: a hum and a whisper at either ear
sleep: note("a2").slow(8).s("hum").azimuth(-70).distance(3).gain(.12)
death: s("whisper").slow(4).syl("<sha ha>").azimuth(70).distance(4).lpf(2000).gain(.08)

// Stars coming out, one by one
stars: n(irand(8).segment(8)).scale("A:minor pentatonic").transpose(24)
  .degradeBy(.85).seed("nyx")
  .s("sine").fm(3).fmh(2.76).decay(1.5).sustain(0).release(2)
  .pan(rand).room(.8).size(.95).gain(.08)

crickets: s("insect").slow(4).distance(7).gain(.08)

sketches.name: Kronos
sketches.description: The Titan who devoured his children: three clocks of five, six and seven ticks, a heavy pendulum, an hourglass that keeps turning over and a scythe every four bars.
sketches.source:
setcpm(84/4)

// Time devours its children: three clocks of five, six and seven ticks
clock1: s("{tick tick tick tick tick}%8").pan(.25).gain(.18)
clock2: s("{rim ~ rim ~ rim ~}%8").pan(.75).gain(.14)
clock3: s("{click ~ ~ click ~ click ~}%8").hpf(2000).gain(.12)

// A heavy pendulum swinging between two low notes
pendulum: note("c2 g1").s("sawtooth").lpf(500)
  .attack(.05).decay(.8).sustain(.3).release(.6).gain(.32)

// A falling line that rotates its starting point, like an hourglass turned over
sand: n("7 6 5 4 3 2 1 0").scale("C:minor").s("triangle").timbre("glass")
  .iter(4).decay(.3).sustain(0).release(.4).delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.2)

// The scythe: a dark swell every four bars
scythe: note("<[c3,eb3,gb3] ~ ~ ~>").s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.3)
  .lpf(800).lpenv(2).attack(1).release(3).room(.7).gain(.18)

sketches.name: Helios
sketches.description: The sun chariot climbs the sky: bright Lydian arpeggios, golden brass, the hoofbeats of four horses and a long line overhead.
sketches.source:
setcpm(116/4)

// The sun chariot climbs: bright lydian arpeggios
arp: n("0 2 4 6 7 9 11 14").scale("D:lydian").s("square").pw(.3)
  .decay(.1).sustain(0).lpf(3000).delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).delayfeedback(.4).gain(.16)

// Golden brass holding wide chords: D, E/D, D, C
brass: note("<[d3,a3,f#4] [e3,b3,g#4] [d3,a3,f#4] [c3,g3,e4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2).lpf(1400).lpenv(2).lpattack(.2)
  .attack(.3).release(1.2).room(.5).gain(.24)

// Hoofbeats of the four horses
horses: s("[lt ~ lt lt]*2, hh*8").lpf(3000).room(.3).gain(.4)

bass: note("<d2 e2 d2 c2>").s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.4).sustain(.5).release(.2).gain(.42)

// A long bright line overhead
lead: note("<a4 b4 [d5@3 c#5] [e5@2 g#4@2]>").s("sine").timbre("hollow")
  .vib(5).vibdepth(.1).attack(.1).sustain(.6).release(.6).room(.5).gain(.22)

sketches.name: Zeus
sketches.description: The king of the gods in the storm over Olympus: rolling thunder, crashing bolts, commanding brass in D minor, driving strings and a choir.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)

// Storm clouds gather over Olympus
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.6).gain(.26)
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.5).gain(.14)

// Thunder: low drums rolling, a crash for each bolt
thunder: s("<[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ lt ~] [bd lt bd lt] [bd*2 lt*4 lt*2]>")
  .speed(.6).lpf(700).room(.8).size(.9).gain(.6)
bolts: s("<~ ~ cr ~ ~ cr ~ cr>").room(.8).gain(.35)

// The king of the gods: brass in D minor, commanding
brass: note("<[d3,a3,d4] [d3,a3,d4] [bb2,f3,d4] [c3,g3,e4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .lpf(1000).lpenv(2.5).lpattack(.1)
  .attack(.1).release(1).room(.6).gain(.28)

// Strings driving underneath
strings: note("d3 d3 a2 d3 f3 d3 a2 d3").add("<0 0 -4 -2>")
  .s("sawtooth").attack(.01).decay(.12).sustain(.4).release(.08)
  .lpf(sine.range(800, 2600).slow(8)).room(.4).gain(.24)

choir: note("<~ [d4,f4,a4] ~ [e4,g4,c5]>").s("choir").syl("ah")
  .attack(.4).release(1.5).room(.7).gain(.28)

sketches.name: Hera
sketches.description: The queen of the gods in procession: a stately waltz-time organ, a proud, ornamented peacock melody, a choir and hall bells.
sketches.source:
setcpm(66/3)

// Queen of the gods: a stately processional in 3/4
organ: note("<[g2,d3,g3,b3] [c3,e3,g3,c4] [a2,e3,a3,c4] [d3,f#3,a3,c4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("organ").lpf(1600)
  .attack(.2).sustain(.8).release(1).room(.6).gain(.2)

// Her peacock: a proud, ornamented melody
melody: note("<[d5 b4 g4] [e5@2 c5] [c5 b4 a4] [a4@2 f#4]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.12).attack(.05).sustain(.6).release(.5)
  .delay(.25).delaytime(1/3).room(.5).gain(.26)

// Processional drums on the downbeat
drums: s("lt ~ ~, ~ rim rim").room(.4).gain(.38)

// The court sings, and bells ring in the hall
choir: note("<[g3,b3,d4] [g3,c4,e4] [a3,c4,e4] [a3,d4,f#4]>")
  .s("choir").syl("<ah oh ah oh>").attack(.8).release(2).space("hall").gain(.22)
bells: note("<g5 ~ ~ ~ d5 ~ ~ ~>").s("sine").fm(3).fmh(2.41)
  .decay(3).sustain(0).release(3).space("hall").gain(.12)

sketches.name: Poseidon
sketches.description: The earthshaker: heavy surf, a deep bass swell that rises and falls like a wave, a conch horn calling and light glinting on the water.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)

// The sea, wide and heavy
surf: s("surf").slow(8).intensity(.6).gain(.32)

// The earthshaker: a deep bass swell rising and falling like a wave
deep: note("<d1 d1 bb0 c1>").slow(2).s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.3)
  .lpf(sine.range(150, 600).slow(8)).attack(2).sustain(1).release(3).gain(.3)

// A conch horn calling across the water
conch: note("<[a3@3 d4] ~ [c4@3 a3] ~>").s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").vowel("o")
  .attack(.3).sustain(.7).release(1).lpf(1500).space("hall").gain(.22)

// Light dancing on the waves
glints: n("<[0 ~ 4 ~] [~ 2 ~ 5] [7 ~ ~ 4] [~ 2 ~ ~]>").scale("D:dorian").transpose(12)
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(.5).sustain(0).release(1)
  .pan(sine.slow(8)).delay(.4).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.5).gain(.16)

pad: note("<[d3,a3,e4] [d3,a3,f4] [bb2,f3,d4] [c3,g3,e4]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3)
  .attack(2).release(4).lpf(1100).room(.8).size(.9).gain(.14)

sketches.name: Hades
sketches.description: Beneath the earth: a drone in the dark, a choir of shades heard through stone, water dripping into the Styx, Cerberus growling behind you and the ferryman's bell.

sketches.name: Persephone
sketches.description: Between two worlds: four bars of spring above ground, with a flute, harp and birdsong, then four bars of winter in the halls below, as the same harp turns minor. A low pulse carries the pomegranate through both.
sketches.source:
setcpm(80/4)

// Four bars of spring above ground, four bars of winter below
const spring = "<1 1 1 1 0 0 0 0>"
const winter = "<0 0 0 0 1 1 1 1>"

// Spring: a bright flute, a harp and birdsong
flute: note("<[e5 g5 a5 b5] [d6@2 b5 a5] [g5 e5 d5 e5] [g5@4]>").mask(spring)
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.1).attack(.05).sustain(.5).release(.4)
  .delay(.25).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.24)
harp: note("<[g3 b3 d4 b3] [c4 e4 g4 e4] [e3 g3 b3 g3] [d3 f#3 a3 f#3]>").mask(spring)
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.5).room(.5).gain(.22)
birds: s("bird").slow(2).mask(spring).azimuth(40).distance(4).gain(.2)

// Winter: the harp turns minor, slow and dark in the halls of Hades
dark: note("<[e3 g3 b3 g3] [c3 eb3 g3 eb3] [a2 c3 e3 c3] [b2 d#3 f#3 d#3]>").mask(winter)
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.8).sustain(0).release(1)
  .lpf(1200).space("church").gain(.22)
wind: s("wind").slow(4).mask(winter).intensity(.4).gain(.14)

// Pomegranate seeds: a low pulse that carries through both worlds
seeds: note("<g2 c2 e2 d2>").s("sine").attack(.3).sustain(.7).release(1).gain(.3)

sketches.name: Athena
sketches.description: Wisdom and strategy: a measured two-voice invention in the old Greek Dorian mode (E to E on the white keys), a disciplined march and an owl watching from above.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/4)

// Wisdom: a measured two-voice invention in the old Greek Dorian mode, E to E
upper: note("<[e4 f4 g4 a4 b4 a4 g4 f4] [e4 g4 c5 b4 a4 g4 a4 b4] [c5 b4 a4 g4 f4 e4 f4 d4] [e4@4 ~ e4 f4 g4]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.25).sustain(.3).release(.2)
  .pan(.35).room(.4).gain(.26)
lower: note("<[e3@2 c3@2 d3@2 b2@2] [c3@2 a2@2 f2@2 g2@2] [a2@2 c3@2 d3@2 b2@2] [e2@4 b2@4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(900).attack(.02).decay(.3).sustain(.5).release(.2)
  .pan(.65).gain(.24)

// A disciplined march: shields and spears in formation
drums: s("lt ~ lt ~ lt ~ [lt lt] ~, ~ ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~").room(.3).gain(.4)

// The owl watches from above
owl: note("<~ ~ ~ [e5@3 c5]>").s("hum").elevation(40).distance(5).gain(.14)

sketches.name: Apollo
sketches.description: The god of music and light: a lyre plucking a hymn over a kithara drone, a solo voice singing his praise and golden bells in the sun temple.
sketches.source:
setcpm(72/4)

// The god of music: a lyre plucking a hymn
lyre: note("<[e3 b3 e4 g4 b4 g4 e4 b3] [d3 a3 d4 f4 a4 f4 d4 a3] [c3 g3 c4 e4 g4 e4 c4 g3] [b2 f#3 b3 d4 f#4 d4 b3 f#3]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").attack(.002).decay(.6).sustain(0).release(.7)
  .pan(.4).room(.5).gain(.28)

// A solo voice sings his praise: i-o pa-i, a-po-lo
hymn: note("<[b4@3 a4 g4@2 a4 b4] [a4@4 f4@2 e4@2] [g4@3 e4 c5@2 b4 a4] [b4@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("voice").syl("<[i o pa i] [a po lo] [ka li] [o _]>")
  .voicetype("alto").mono(1).vglide(.08).attack(.1).release(.8).space("hall").gain(.34)

// A drone of fifths, like a kithara's open strings
drone: note("[e2,b2]").slow(4).s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").lpf(1200)
  .attack(.02).decay(2).sustain(.4).release(3).room(.5).gain(.16)

// Golden bells of the sun temple
bells: note("<e5 ~ b4 ~>").s("sine").fm(2).fmh(2.76)
  .decay(3).sustain(0).release(3).space("hall").gain(.12)

sketches.name: Artemis
sketches.description: The huntress in 6/8: hunting horns through the moonlit forest, hooves and hounds, quick silver arrows of notes and birds flying overhead.
sketches.source:
setcpm(120/2)

// One cycle is a bar of 6/8. The hunt is on: horns through the forest
horns: note("<[d4 ~ a4 a4 ~ f#4] [d4 ~ a4 d5 ~ a4] [b4 ~ a4 g4 ~ e4] [f#4 ~ e4 d4 ~ ~]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.1).lpf(1600).lpenv(1.5).lpattack(.05)
  .attack(.04).sustain(.6).release(.3).room(.5).gain(.26)

// Hooves and hounds
drums: s("lt ~ lt lt ~ lt, ~ ~ ~ mt ~ ~, hh*6").lpf(3000).room(.3).gain(.42)
bass: note("<d2 d2 g2 a2>").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~").s("sine")
  .decay(.4).sustain(.4).release(.2).gain(.4)

// Her silver bow: quick arrows of notes
arrows: note("<~ [d5 e5 f#5 a5 d6 ~] ~ [a5 f#5 e5 d5 ~ ~]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(.15).sustain(0)
  .pan(saw).delay(.3).delaytime(1/6).gain(.18)

// The moonlit forest all around
birds: s("bird").slow(2).azimuth(saw.range(-120, 120).slow(8)).distance(5).posglide(.3).gain(.2)
breeze: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.2).gain(.08)

sketches.name: Ares
sketches.description: The god of war: relentless drums, a distorted bronze riff in E Phrygian, battle horns and the roar of the army.
sketches.source:
setcpm(132/4)

// War drums: a relentless march
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").shape(.3).gain(.8),
  s("~ sd ~ [sd sd]").room(.3).gain(.6),
  s("lt lt mt lt lt mt ht mt").speed(.8).lpf(1500).gain(.45),
  s("<~ ~ ~ cr>").room(.6).gain(.35)
)

// Bronze clashing: a distorted low riff in E Phrygian
riff: note("e2 e2 f2 e2 g2 e2 f2 d2")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.2).shape(.4).lpf(1200).lpq(4)
  .decay(.15).sustain(.4).release(.05).gain(.38)

// Battle horns
horns: note("[e3,b3,e4]@3 [f3,c4,f4] [e3,b3,e4]@2 [d3,a3,d4]@2").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2).lpf(1400).lpenv(2).lpattack(.02)
  .attack(.02).release(.3).room(.5).gain(.28)

// The army roars
crowd: s("crowd").slow(8).intensity(.6).gain(.14)
shout: note("<~ ~ ~ [e4 ~ e4 ~]>").s("aah").attack(.02).release(.4).room(.5).gain(.25)

sketches.name: Aphrodite
sketches.description: Born from the sea foam: tender Rhodes chords, a voice singing of love, a lazy swung kit, soft surf and a shimmer in the echoes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(76/4)

// Born from the sea foam
surf: s("surf").slow(8).intensity(.3).gain(.22)

// Warm, tender chords: Fmaj9, Em7, Dm9, Cmaj7
keys: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4,g4] [e3,g3,b3,d4] [d3,f3,a3,c4,e4] [c3,e3,g3,b3]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ [~ x] ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sine").fm(1.1).fmh(2).trem(3).tremdepth(.2)
  .decay(1).sustain(.3).release(1).lpf(2200).room(.5).gain(.28)

// A voice sings of love
voice: note("<[a4@3 g4 e4@4] [g4@3 f4 d4@4] [f4@2 e4 d4 c4@4] [e4@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("voice").syl("<la lo mo a>")
  .voicetype("alto").mono(1).vglide(.1).attack(.1).release(1).room(.6).gain(.32)

// Soft bass and a lazy kit
bass: note("<f2 e2 d2 c2>").s("sine").shape(.1).decay(.6).sustain(.4).release(.4).gain(.4)
drums: s("bd ~ ~ bd, ~ rim ~ rim, hh*8").swing(4).lpf(3500).gain(.32)

// A shimmer of sea foam
shimmer: note("<e5 ~ d5 ~>").s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(.6).sustain(0).release(1)
  .delay(.4).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.45).room(.6).gain(.12)

sketches.name: Hephaestus
sketches.description: The forge under the volcano: roaring fire and bellows, hammer on a ringing anvil, mechanical automatons at work and molten metal glowing.
sketches.source:
setcpm(92/4)

// The forge under the volcano
fire: s("fire").slow(4).intensity(.7).density(14).gain(.3)
bellows: s("brown").slow(2).lpf(sine.range(200, 800)).gain(.12)

// Hammer on anvil: metal rings with every strike
anvil: note("c5 ~ c5 ~ c5 [c5 c5] ~ c5").s("sine").fm(5).fmh(3.7)
  .decay(.3).sustain(0).release(.4).room(.3).gain(.24)
hammer: s("bd ~ bd ~ bd [bd bd] ~ bd").lpf(400).shape(.3).gain(.55)

// The automatons at work: a mechanical bass ostinato
gears: note("c2 c2 eb2 c2 f2 c2 eb2 g1").s("square").pw(.3).lpf(700).lpq(4)
  .decay(.12).sustain(.2).release(.05).gain(.3)
machine: s("engine").slow(4).lpf(600).distance(3).gain(.14)

// Molten metal glowing
glow: note("<[c3,g3,eb4] [ab2,eb3,c4]>").slow(2).s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.25)
  .lpf(900).attack(1).release(2).room(.5).gain(.14)

sketches.name: Hermes
sketches.description: The messenger on winged sandals: a fast break, notes darting from ear to ear, a trickster bass and two lines winding around each other like the caduceus.
sketches.source:
setcpm(172/4)

// The messenger: winged sandals and a fast break
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~, ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd?0.3 ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").gain(.75),
  s("hh*16").hpf(8000).gain("[.3 .15 .2 .15]*4")
)

// Notes darting from ear to ear
runner: n("0 2 4 7 9 7 4 2").add("<0 3 5 4>").scale("A:minor pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.25).decay(.08).sustain(0).iter(4)
  .pan(square).delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.16)

// The trickster's bass
bass: note("<a1 c2 d2 e2>").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~").s("sawtooth").lpf(800).lpq(3)
  .decay(.2).sustain(.4).release(.08).gain(.45)

// The caduceus: two lines winding around each other
snake1: note("<[a4 c5 e5 c5] [g4 b4 d5 b4]>").s("triangle").timbre("glass")
  .decay(.2).sustain(0).pan(sine.fast(2)).gain(.16)
snake2: note("<[e5 c5 a4 c5] [d5 b4 g4 b4]>").s("triangle").timbre("glass")
  .decay(.2).sustain(0).pan(cosine.fast(2)).late(1/16).gain(.14)

sketches.name: Dionysus
sketches.description: The revel: a crowd and frame drums that get looser as the night goes on, a wild aulos over a reed drone, a slightly drunk lyre and maenads crying out.
sketches.source:
setcpm(116/4)

// The revel: a crowd, wine and dancing
crowd: s("crowd").slow(8).intensity(.6).gain(.16)

// Frame drums and finger cymbals, getting looser as the night goes on
drums: s("lt ~ rim lt ~ lt rim ~, hh*8?0.3")
  .sometimesBy(.3, x => x.ply(2)).swing(4).room(.3).gain(.45)

// The aulos: a double reed, wild and ornamented
aulos: note("<[e4 f4 g#4 a4 b4 a4 g#4 f4] [e4@2 f4 e4 d4@2 e4@2] [a4 b4 c5 b4 a4 g#4 f4 g#4] [f4 e4 d4 f4 e4@4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").vowel("a").mono(1).glide(.05).vib(6).vibdepth(.25)
  .attack(.03).sustain(.6).release(.2).lpf(2800).pan(.6).room(.4).gain(.28)
drone: note("[e2,b2]").s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").lpf(700)
  .attack(.3).sustain(1).release(1).gain(.18)

// The lyre strums along, a little drunk
lyre: note("<[e3,g#3,b3] [d3,f3,a3] [a2,c3,e3] [d3,f3,a3]>").struct("x ~ x x ~ x ~ x")
  .degradeBy(.2).seed("wine")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.3).sustain(0).release(.3).pan(.35).gain(.24)

// Maenads crying out
maenads: note("<~ ~ ~ [e4 ~ g#4 ~]>").s("aah").attack(.02).release(.5).room(.5).gain(.24)

sketches.name: Pan
sketches.description: The goat-footed god plays his pipes in a meadow in 6/8, with dancing hooves, insects, birds and a stream, and now and then a sudden panic.
sketches.source:
setcpm(104/2)

// One cycle is a bar of 6/8. The goat-footed god plays his pipes in the meadow
pipes: note("<[g5 a5 b5 d6 b5 a5] [g5 ~ e5 d5 ~ e5] [g5 b5 d6 e6 d6 b5] [a5 g5 e5 g5@2 ~]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.15).attack(.04).sustain(.5).release(.3)
  .gain(.24).off(1/12, x => x.add(-12).gain(.12))
  .delay(.2).delaytime(1/6).room(.4)

// Hooves dancing and a simple bass
drums: s("lt ~ rim lt rim ~, hh*6?0.4").room(.3).gain(.36)
bass: note("<g2 e2 c2 d2>").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~").s("triangle")
  .decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.2).gain(.38)

// Meadow life all around
insects: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(-90).distance(3).gain(.12)
birds: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(60).distance(4).gain(.2)
stream: s("stream").slow(4).distance(5).gain(.14)

// And now and then, a sudden panic
panic: note("<~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [g2,c#3,g3]>").s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.4).shape(.3)
  .lpf(2000).attack(.01).release(.8).gain(.22)

sketches.name: Hypnos
sketches.description: Headphones on: the god of sleep in his cave by the river Lethe. A gentle 2 Hz binaural drone, a poppy-warm pad and dreams drifting past from his sons Morpheus, Phobetor and Phantasos.
sketches.source:
setcpm(40/4)

// The god of sleep in his cave: a 2 Hz binaural drone, below the 3-30 Hz warning range
drone: note("<f1 f1 db1 eb1>").slow(4).s("sine").binaural(2)
  .attack(4).sustain(1).release(6).gain(.3)

// Poppies: a warm pad that barely moves
pad: note("<[f2,c3,ab3,eb4] [db2,ab2,f3,c4]>").slow(8).s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3)
  .attack(6).release(8).lpf(600).room(.8).size(.95).gain(.1)

// The river of forgetting
lethe: s("stream").slow(8).lpf(1200).distance(5).gain(.16)

// Dreams drifting past: Morpheus, Phobetor and Phantasos
dreams: n(irand(6).segment(4)).scale("F:minor pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.7).seed("hypnos")
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(1.5).sustain(0).release(2)
  .pan(rand).delay(.4).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.45).room(.7).gain(.12)
